summary.text: AJ Johnson is the Democratic candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 64 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Tom Weber (R).
Johnson is a retired U.S. Army Master Sergeant who has worked as a high school Army JROTC instructor.

paragraphs.text: Johnson served in the U.S. Army from 1983 to 2009.

According to Ballotpedia, he earned a bachelor's degree from Excelsior College in 2009 and a graduate degree from the American College of Education in 2023, and his career experience includes working as a teacher.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Johnson said he was born in a small town in Mississippi, served 26 years on active duty and retired as a Master Sergeant, and has spent 17 years as a high school Army JROTC instructor.
Johnson said in the survey that he is a longtime Lake County resident and a member of the Lake County Sheriff's Merit Commission.

He described affordability as a central priority and said he supports increasing the state's share of education funding to reduce reliance on local property taxes and strengthening homeowner and senior relief.
He won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary without opposition.
